notes: Corrected the target head of the אֲשֶׁר unit from him to that. The edges are right under rule 46's first rider — a present relative takes the that together with the supplied antecedent — but rule 24 anchors the head on the token realizing the source head's lexeme, and that is the relative's own word. Rule 41 heads him that on him only because there the supplied pronoun is the whole of what the article is rendered by; rule 46 states the converse for a written relative.
him that goes to the written אֲשֶׁר, so the him is not a supplied object of the verb; the verb keeps hold ... guiltless, headed on the complement (rule 44).
